player_prompt.intro:
Efe Player {player_id} le Indian Poker gome la.
- 52-kɔnta kɔnta; mi wɔ na kuɖe dɔ la.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) etɔ̃, {max_rounds} etɔ̃ la.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X nyɛ positive integer <= kuɖe chip count)
- Highest hidden card diɖi pot le showdown la.
